name: Gladys Ganda
detail: Spoke on tax equity stating "those who have more must contribute more", but made no specific reference to net wealth taxation.

name: Top 40% PAYE Income Tax Band
detail: Progressive income tax band on monthly earnings above K10 million enacted by Parliament; targets income rather than stock of wealth.

name: Estate Duty Act
detail: Inheritance tax on deceased estates (up to 11%); excluded under Section 2.

name: Minimum Alternative Tax (MAT)
detail: Turnover-based corporate levy; corporate taxation is excluded under Section 2.

name: Mobile Money Transfer Levy
detail: Financial transaction levy; excluded under Section 2.

name: Goodall Gondwe
detail: Former Minister of Finance; passed away in August 2023.

name: Saulos Chilima
detail: Former Vice President and UTM founder; passed away in June 2024.
